description: Stew-MAP: Stewardship Mapping & Assessment Project is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USFS | Northern Research Station. This framework facilitates team efforts to compile information about environmental stewardship efforts across a metropolitan area. A range of end-users can benefit by using the populated database and associated map to connect interested groups with local projects. A primary goal of the project is to help end users visualize stewardship activities across their urban landscape. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Cultural and Community Services, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
